scenarios.name: Moderate downturn
scenarios.rationale: A moderate fall in volumes lowers earnings from the {{FIG:ebitda_ltm|US$ m}} twelve-month level while debt of {{FIG:total_debt_ltm|US$ m}} and cash interest stay as reported.

scenarios.name: Severe downturn
scenarios.rationale: A severe fall in volumes cuts earnings by a larger share of the {{FIG:ebitda_ltm|US$ m}} twelve-month level; debt and cash interest stay as reported.

scenarios.name: Severe downturn with higher rates
scenarios.rationale: The severe fall in volumes coincides with a rise in the rate paid on the term loan.
scenarios.limitation: No rate curve or hedging disclosure supports the size of the interest increase.

scenarios.name: Total loss of earnings
scenarios.rationale: A boundary case in which earnings fall to zero; it shows which ratios stop being meaningful and which stay calculable.

thresholds.label: Total leverage watch level
thresholds.rationale: An internal watch level, not a covenant; no covenant source is bound to this run.

thresholds.label: Net leverage watch level
thresholds.rationale: An internal watch level, not a covenant; no covenant source is bound to this run.

thresholds.label: Interest coverage watch level
thresholds.rationale: An internal watch level, not a covenant; no covenant source is bound to this run.

assessment.rationale: The credit starts from total leverage of {{FIG:total_leverage_reported|x}}, net leverage of {{FIG:net_leverage_reported|x}}, interest coverage of {{FIG:interest_coverage_reported|x}} and free cash flow of {{FIG:fcf_ltm|US$ m}}; the scenarios test how far earnings can fall before those measures reach the watch levels.
assessment.limitation: Scenario sizes and watch levels are analyst assumptions.

gaps.gap: No covenant document or maturity schedule is an input to this stress.
gaps.why_it_matters: The watch levels are the analyst's, so the order in which lenders' own tests are reached may differ from the order shown.
gaps.action: Run the covenant owner and compare its tests with the watch levels.

revenue_growth.rationale: Modest growth from the {{FIG:revenue_ltm|US$ m}} twelve-month revenue base, with no price or volume guidance in the source pack.
revenue_growth.limitation: No management guidance or consensus supports the growth rates.

ebitda_margin.rationale: The margin starts at the {{FIG:ebitda_margin_ltm|%}} twelve-month level and widens slowly as fixed costs are spread over higher revenue.
ebitda_margin.limitation: Margin expansion is an analyst view; the source pack states no cost programme.

capex_pct_revenue.rationale: Capital expenditure is held at a steady share of revenue, close to the twelve-month level of {{FIG:capex_to_revenue_ltm|%}}.

tax_wc_pct_revenue.rationale: Cash taxes and working capital together stay at the twelve-month share of revenue.

interest_rate.rationale: The rate is held at the level implied by twelve-month cash interest on the closing debt of {{FIG:total_debt_ltm|US$ m}}.

dividends.rationale: Distributions are cut below the twelve-month level to protect cash; the cut is the analyst's assumption.
dividends.limitation: No dividend policy is disclosed in the source pack.

debt_repayment.rationale: Repayments start in the second year from surplus cash; they are an analyst assumption, not a mandatory schedule.

downside.rationale: The downside takes the CP-2A scenario with the larger earnings fall and the higher rate, held in every forecast year: earnings fall by its decline and the rate paid rises by its increase.
downside.limitation: The shock is persistent and no mitigating action is modelled.

minimum_liquidity.rationale: The source pack states no minimum liquidity requirement, so none is assumed.

assessment.rationale: Opening total leverage is {{FIG:total_leverage_reported|x}}; the base case deleverages through retained cash flow and repayments, while the downside reaches the watch levels in the first forecast year and runs short of cash in the second.
assessment.limitation: Earnings quality and minimum liquidity were not assessed.

gaps.gap: Earnings quality and minimum liquidity are not inputs to the forecast.
gaps.why_it_matters: Without them the starting earnings are taken as reported and the liquidity break is not tested.
gaps.action: Run the earnings-quality owner and assess a minimum liquidity, then rerun the forecast.

The kpi keys ebitda, fcf, total_debt and cash_closing are the ones the frozen CP-2G entry already uses. {{INPUTS_SHA256}} is the content hash of the step's prefilled DownstreamInputs.

views.rationale: Total debt to EBITDA leaves {T2R.4.t01.headroom|x} of headroom to the downgrade trigger on the latest reported fiscal year, and the base case widens it. In the downside case the cash interest coverage and free cash flow triggers are both reached in the first forecast year, so the pressure comes from the downside path rather than from today's figures.

evidence.quote: S&P  Downgrade  Total debt to EBITDA  Above  2.75x
S&P  Downgrade  EBITDA to cash interest  Below  3.50x
"rating": "BB"

views.limitation: The downside path rests on an analyst-chosen CP-2A shock and on CP-2G's analyst-assumed drivers.

views.rationale: The net debt to EBITDA downgrade trigger leaves {T2R.4.t04.headroom|x} of headroom on the latest reported fiscal year and is not reached in the base case; in the downside case it is reached from the second forecast year. The upgrade trigger is reached in the base case only in the final forecast year, so an upgrade is not near.

evidence.quote: Moody's  Downgrade  Net debt to EBITDA  Above  2.25x
Moody's  Upgrade  Net debt to EBITDA  Below  0.50x
"rating": "Ba3"

views.limitation: Both agencies' terms are read at fiscal year end; sustained-period conditions are not stated in the source.

overall.rationale: On reported figures the issuer starts with {{FIG:total_leverage_reported|x}} total leverage and {{FIG:net_leverage_reported|x}} net leverage, inside every published downgrade trigger. The two agencies' ratings differ by {T2R.8.p01.notches|notches} on the combined scale, and the downside forecast, not the opening position, is what puts a rating review in reach.
overall.limitation: Every forecast driver behind the forward headroom is an analyst assumption without a source citation.

gaps.gap: No agency report states how long a trigger must be breached before a rating review.
gaps.why_it_matters: Reaching a trigger in one fiscal year may not be a rating event, so the timing is the earliest possible, not the expected.
gaps.action: Obtain the agencies' full criteria and rerun the trigger test.
